title: Update or disclaim docs/scenarios/stitch-prompts/{03-mode-selection,04-curriculum-selection,06-dashboard}.md — describe a product IA the shipped app doesn't have
rule: Tier-4 triage AREA NOTE — presents-as-current classification; egregious contradiction with reality

evidence.quote: First onboarding screen where user selects their learning mode (Self-Learner, Parent, or Tutor).

why: These prompts are literal AI-image-generation inputs for the WDS/Stitch design workflow (docs/index.md calls the folder 'AI-generated UI design prompts'; see the bmad-wds-stitch-generation skill) — their whole purpose is to be re-run to produce mockups. Three of them describe a product model the app doesn't have: onboarding mode selection is framed as Self-Learner/Parent/Tutor here vs. the actual child/adult-per-profile choice in code; curriculum selection lists exactly 5 curricula ('5 Scrollable Cards') vs. the real 9-value CurriculumId enum (missing Nach, Tanach, Mishneh Torah, Mussar); and the dashboard bottom nav lists 5 tabs (Home/Browse/Progress/Calendar/More) vs. the real 4-tab app_shell.dart (Dashboard/Learn/Progress/Settings). Unlike every file in the dashboard-redesign-set and evolution-set, none of the 7 stitch-prompts carry any staleness/inspiration-only disclaimer, so re-running them today would generate polished mockups for the wrong information architecture.
recommendation: Update 03-mode-selection.md, 04-curriculum-selection.md, and 06-dashboard.md to match the current onboarding (child/adult mode), the full 9-curriculum roster, and the real 4-tab nav — or add a one-line 'early concept, not current IA' disclaimer to the whole stitch-prompts set the way dashboard-redesign-set and evolution/ already do.
acceptance_criteria: 03-mode-selection.md describes child/adult mode selection, or is explicitly marked as a superseded early concept.
04-curriculum-selection.md's curriculum list matches lib/core/enums/curriculum_id.dart (9 values), or is marked non-exhaustive/example-only.
06-dashboard.md's bottom-nav section matches lib/app/router/app_shell.dart (4 tabs: Dashboard, Learn, Progress, Settings), or is marked as an earlier concept.
